caption: The video captures a wide view of a calm river under a clear blue sky. A large leafless tree stands rooted in the middle of the water, its bare trunk and branches mirrored on the glassy surface. Dry golden reeds fill the foreground along both banks, while grassy brown hillsides slope in from the left and right. A faint snow-streaked ridge sits in the distance, and the framing holds steady. The water and the tree's reflection show small, slowly varying ripple distortions, with bright sky patches and the dark trunk silhouette wavering gently on the surface. The foreground reeds and grass tufts at the bottom edges show none of this movement, holding their positions. The trunk, branches, hills and sky keep fixed positions, so the quiet composition holds as the faint water motion continues.
relations: Small water-surface ripples slowly distort the tree's mirrored reflection and bright sky patches on the glassy surface.
The rooted trunk, branches, hills and sky keep fixed positions while only the water texture varies gently.
Foreground golden reeds and grass tufts remain motionless, holding their edges despite the water's subtle movement.
The steady wide framing persists as faint ripple distortions continue across the calm river surface.
